detail: Confirmed in this session: tool namespaces mcp__twining__* (project, @next) and mcp__plugin_twining_twining__* (plugin, ^1.20.0) are both registered. Facts: (1) 1.24.1 DOES have the node:sqlite backend with SQLITE_SCHEMA_VERSION=2, identical to 2.0.0-beta.2's, so both processes open .twining/twining.db under WAL — SQLite-level concurrency is safe today. (2) Live db PRAGMA user_version=2. (3) Real risks are not corruption but: divergent business logic (v1 writes don't maintain v2 invariants — #34 weight normalization, #31 superseded_by back-links), record export/ingest races on .twining/records/, two dashboards contending for port 24282, nondeterministic model choice between duplicate tool namespaces, and a future schema bump to 3 will make the v1 plugin server fail at startup via the newer-schema guard. (4) Any beta tester who has the plugin installed and follows enrollment instructions that say 'add .mcp.json with twining-mcp@next' will reproduce this dual-server state.
summary: Beta enrollment creates dual twining servers: project .mcp.json pins @next (2.0.0-beta.2) while installed plugin 1.11.1 .mcp.json pins ^1.20.0 (→1.24.1); both open the same .twining/twining.db WAL
